title: Gateway Drops Task ID
summary: The gateway dropped the task_id when proxying to A2A backend agents, breaking multi-turn conversations and causing stateful agents to create new isolated conversations
root_cause: Hardcoded JSONRPC id field and dropped task_id in gateway
resolution: Extract task_id from inbound parameters and include it in the outbound JSONRPC payload
impact_description: Multi-turn conversations were impossible, and stateful agents could not maintain conversation history
